work.span_2: Field notes · client names kept private
work.h2_3: Most client work is under NDA. So each case shows how it was built rather than who it was for.
work.h3_14: A shop site built on one angle
work.p_16: Every slanted edge on the site uses the 22° angle from the store's shelving, from the wide desktop layout down to the phone. The slider shows a hint of the next colour just before it changes.
work.p_23: Search data and an image model decide how each product photo is named, described and tagged. Several hundred photos a day go through it, and nobody renames files by hand any more.
work.h3_28: An outdoor guide you can tilt
work.p_30: Routes drawn on a live 3D relief, with pages that load in under a second on hotel wifi. Lighthouse on mobile: 97 on the home page and 99 on route pages.

services.span_5: Motion-rich sites and CMS builds, made side by side with your designers and handed over so your team can run them.
services.span_12: Practical workshops on coding assistants, then the small tools and workflows your team actually needs, plus a plain list of what not to automate.
services.span_18: Assistants and search that answer from your client's own content, tested on real user questions and showing their sources.
